user.title: Set up K93 ANS
user.description: K93 ANS centralizes notification handling: recipients, channels and history are configured afterwards from the integration's Configure options.

abort.already_configured: K93 ANS is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

edit_recipient.title: Recipient
edit_recipient.description: Saving after adding a channel to "Allowed channels" reopens this form with an extra "Importance for" field for it, letting you override the minimum importance for just that channel.

data.name: Name
data.interactive_entity_id: Interactive sensor (optional - a binary_sensor that's "on" while this recipient's phone is in use; required for the live notification inactivity timeout below)
data.min_importance: Minimum importance (default; overridable per channel below)

data.name: Name
data.color: Icon color (CSS color, e.g. #ff0000 or red - blank = theme default)

data.language: Language (used for outgoing notification text, e.g. the Acknowledge action button)
data.live_inactivity_timeout_minutes: Live notification inactivity timeout (minutes, 0 = disabled) - clears a live notification's push for a recipient once their interactive sensor has been "off" this long
data.storage_path: Notification history storage directory (blank = default K93-Advanced-Notification-System folder). Absolute, or relative to the Home Assistant config directory; must be writable by Home Assistant. The database.json file inside it is named that regardless. Existing history is migrated automatically. Takes effect as soon as you save.
